row.title: ASHBY-KERNEL-1: Ashby's concepts are kernel code, with model-guided search
row.body: seed/worker/src/ashby.js and organization.js carry the concepts as pure functions; the tick step ashby enforces the second goal from the metrics table. Blind random re-draw is not copied: the homeostat test shows the fully joined search growing far faster than the gated one. The archive forbids reproduction, so seed/autonomy/ashby.json keeps page numbers and our own statements only.
